sentences.en: They've brought baskets or little portable chairs so they can sit down while they wait and they're waiting for it to open.
sentences.zh: 他们带了篮子或便携小椅子，以便在等待时坐下来，他们正等着它开门。

sentences.en: Yes.
So before the pandemic, I had covered pantries and, you know, there would be a few people in line.
sentences.zh: 所以在疫情之前，我报道过食品发放处，你知道的，当时队伍里只有几个人。

sentences.en: If you were walking past, you might not have known that it was a pantry.
sentences.zh: 如果你走过去，你可能根本不知道那是给养发放处。

sentences.en: But when the pandemic hit, the need was just unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 但当疫情来袭时，需求简直大得令人难以置信。

sentences.en: You had job loss, but you also had this pandemic that made it difficult for a lot of people to actually volunteer at the pantries.
sentences.zh: 不仅有人失业，这场疫情还让许多人很难亲自去食品发放处当志愿者。

sentences.en: So a lot of smaller pantries have closed.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多较小的食品发放处都关闭了。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying like a few, like hundreds closed because they were mainly run by elderly volunteers who just could not be exposed to the virus.
sentences.zh: 我不是说只有几个，而是几百个关门了，因为它们主要由老年志愿者运营，而他们根本无法暴露在病毒风险中。

sentences.en: So as the number of people who need food assistance is growing, the number of pantries has actually diminished.
sentences.zh: 所以，随着需要食品援助的人数不断增加，食品发放处的数量实际上却在减少。

sentences.en: So these things are happening at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以这些情况是同时发生的。

sentences.en: Yes.
And one of the reasons you also see so many people in this line is because this line serves a lot of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 你看到这条队伍里有这么多人，原因之一也是因为这个发放处服务了许多移民。

sentences.en: And so it's like, what are you going to do if you've lost your job and you have no public assistance?
sentences.zh: 所以这就成了：如果你失去了工作又没有任何公共救助，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: Getting in this line, you know, this is not a choice.
sentences.zh: 排进这条队伍，你知道，这不是一种选择。

sentences.en: This is a necessity.
From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 人们要等上七、八个小时才能拿到一些食品杂货。

sentences.en: As a million city residents face new food shortages in the wake of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 随着该市百万居民在疫情之后面临新的食品短缺。

sentences.en: Wow, man, something else.

sentences.en: COVID just changed a whole lot of things.

sentences.en: It just changed the entire way of life.
sentences.zh: 它彻底改变了整整一种生活方式。

sentences.en: Today, as we approach Thanksgiving, a holiday defined by food, social services reporter Nikita Stewart with the story of one day at one food pantry in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 今天，在我们迎来以食物为标志的节日感恩节之际，社会服务记者尼基塔·斯图尔特将为我们讲述布鲁克林一家食品发放处一天的故事。

Earlier this fall, I went with daily producers

sentences.en: We meet up with Mohammed Razvi, the executive director and founder of COPO.

sentences.zh: 该组织是一个社区基层组织，旨在帮助我们的美国同胞和新美国人实现他们的美国梦。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: I didn't want to think about poverty.

sentences.zh: 所以我大部分的记者生涯都花在了报道政治和政治腐败上。

sentences.en: And then in 2015, the Times asked me if I would be interested in covering social services.
sentences.zh: 然后在2015年，《时报》问我是否有兴趣报道社会服务。

sentences.en: And I had to ask myself why I hadn't covered social services in all the years that I had been a reporter.
sentences.zh: 我不得不问自己，为什么在我当记者的这些年里，我从来没有报道过社会服务。

sentences.en: And I realized that it was just because it hit too close to home.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，那只是因为这太戳痛处了。

sentences.en: My family went in and out of poverty.

sentences.en: And I remember my sister split her burrito with me.

sentences.en: And that's what we ate that day.

sentences.en: And it's something I'll never forget.

sentences.en: Just thinking about that sharing and the necessity of sharing.

sentences.en: And so it's really hit me during the pandemic, reporting on the people who've been in the lives.

sentences.en: Because I think about, you know, those frozen burritos.

sentences.en: And there's this tendency for people like me, who've experienced poverty, to not talk about it.

sentences.en: You want to forget about it like it didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 你想忘掉它，就像它从没发生过一样。

sentences.en: But if we all keep this secret, it creates a stigma where there shouldn't be one.

sentences.en: So I'm glad I'm able to talk about my family's poverty now, at least a little bit.

sentences.zh: 还有全国数千万依赖救济站勉强生存的人。

sentences.en: You show up at a pantry and you wait for hours and they might run out of food.
sentences.zh: 你出现在救济站，等了几个小时，而他们可能已经把食物发完了。

sentences.en: And if you're struggling financially, you can give up certain things.
sentences.zh: 如果你在经济上苦苦挣扎，你可以放弃某些东西。

sentences.en: You can give up new clothes and maybe you don't give gifts to your kids or your grandkids this Christmas.
sentences.zh: 你可以不买新衣服，可能在这个圣诞节不给你的孩子或孙子买礼物。

sentences.en: But you can't not eat.
Thank you so much for coming.
Please, right this way.
Let me just give my last ravioli out.
sentences.zh: 让我把最后一份意大利饺发出去。

sentences.en: Muhammad has been on his feet for nine hours non-stop.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德已经连轴转站了九个小时。

sentences.en: Thank you.
Oh no, thank you for being here, guys.
sentences.zh: 哦不，谢谢你们能来，伙计们。

sentences.en: And he's a little worse for wear.
sentences.zh: 而且他看起来有点狼狈。

sentences.en: So should we take account of your state at the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该盘点一下你这一天结束时的状态吗？

sentences.en: You have a bloody finger.
Oh man, that's okay.
You have a lost voice and you have dog poop on your shoe.
sentences.zh: 你嗓子哑了，而且你的鞋子踩到狗屎了。

sentences.en: Oh no.
I gotta wash my feet.
But it's beautiful.
There's no line.
There's no line.
All right, thanks so much.
God bless.
Take care, guys.
Thank you so much.
I really appreciate it.
Thank you.
Good morning, Muhammad.
How are you?
I'm doing wonderful.
Good.
Thank you for taking my call.
I know it's a busy time.
sentences.zh: 我知道现在正是大忙时候。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
So talk to me.
What's going on?
Well, so I guess I'll start here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我从这里开始说吧。

sentences.en: So when we visited you last, it was already six months into the pandemic and people were making the food pantry into a routine.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们上次拜访你时，疫情已经持续了六个月，人们已经把去食品救济站当成了一种日常。

sentences.en: But now it's November.
It's getting cold.
It's getting dark.
We're heading into the winter and the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我们正在走向冬天和节假日。

sentences.en: And it feels like it would be more difficult now to wait outside the food pantry for hours.
sentences.zh: 感觉现在要在食品救济站外面排上几个小时的队会更困难了。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, have you felt a change in people's mood or their approach to the food pantry as it's gotten colder?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，随着天气变冷，你有没有感受到人们的心情或他们对待食品救济站的方式发生了变化？

sentences.en: The mood hasn't changed, but they're still in need.
sentences.zh: 心情没有变，但他们仍然有需求。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going to happen.
But we're trying to purchase these heaters.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在努力购买这些取暖器。

sentences.en: You've never seen in the restaurants, the heaters are in the tents outside.
sentences.zh: 你从未在餐厅见过的那种，放在外面帐篷里的取暖器。

sentences.en: It looks like a little umbrella.
Right.
So they get a little bit of warmth and we're trying to see how we're going to speed it up.
sentences.zh: 这样他们能得到一点温暖，我们正在想办法看看怎么加快发货速度。

sentences.en: Right.
You know, we're just trying.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们只是在努力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Well, tomorrow is Friday.
And so that is the food pantry's day.
sentences.zh: 这也是食品救济站开放的日子。

sentences.en: And will you be opening?
Yeah, we are.
We got like, I'm receiving right now as we speak about, I don't know, a few hundred turkeys for Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 我正跟你们说话呢，就差不多收到了，不知道，几百只感恩节火鸡。

sentences.en: Right.
So I was, yeah, they called me yesterday.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时，对，他们昨天打电话给我。

sentences.en: They said, Mo, you're going to have turkeys.
sentences.zh: 他们说，莫，你们会有火鸡的。

sentences.en: I said, oh, thank God.
You know, I was almost in tears.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时差点哭了。

sentences.en: I was like, I didn't know what I was going to do for Thanksgiving for the people, you know?
sentences.zh: 我就想，我不知道该怎么为人们筹备感恩节了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So they're sending me a trailer of turkeys.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正给我运来一整拖车的火鸡。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh my God, it's going to be so great.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦天哪，这太棒了。

sentences.en: So we're going to be able to distribute it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所以我们明天就能把它们分发下去了。

sentences.en: And, you know, people are going to be so happy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，大家会非常高兴的。

sentences.en: And in terms of like, because last time the line was around the block.
sentences.zh: 关于……因为上次队伍排得绕过了街区。

sentences.en: And so are you still seeing people wait around the block?
sentences.zh: 所以你们现在还看到人们绕着街区排队吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
Absolutely.
Yeah.
Yeah.
There's no way.
Yeah.
I mean, I was just listening to the news.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我刚才在听新闻。

sentences.en: There's no stimulus check or nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有纾困支票，什么都没有。

sentences.en: They're in a deadlock.
And it's going to be even more difficult because it's going to be finished on December, I think, 31St.
sentences.zh: 而且情况会更加困难，因为我想在12月31日就要结束了。

sentences.en: You know, the unemployment checks, the assistance that the federal government's giving.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，失业救济金，联邦政府提供的援助。

sentences.en: So it's really, really more stressful what's going to happen with the people.
sentences.zh: 所以大家将要面临的情况真的、真的更加让人焦虑。

sentences.en: And you mentioned that your own funding could run out by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 你提到你自己的资金可能在年底用完。

sentences.en: Is that still the case?
Yes.
For the food pantry, it's still the case.
sentences.zh: 对食品储藏室来说，情况依然如此。

sentences.en: And we're actually talking to our board members and our private donors trying to figure out how we can raise more funds.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上正在与董事会成员和私人捐赠者交谈，想方设法筹集更多资金。

sentences.en: You know, we need to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们需要这么做。

sentences.en: What happens on January 1st if you don't have more funding?
sentences.zh: 如果筹不到更多资金，1月1日会发生什么？

sentences.en: Honestly, I'm going to, I mean, my staff, I'm going to ask them, please be volunteers for now.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我会，我的意思是，对于我的员工，我会请求他们：暂时先当志愿者吧。

sentences.en: Right now, I have staff almost of one, two, three, four, five, six staff members.
And it might go down to like two staff members and continue on a smaller base.
sentences.zh: 而员工人数可能会降到大约两名，并在一个较小的基础上继续运作。

sentences.en: And we're going to just dwindle down.
sentences.zh: 我们将不得不逐渐缩减规模。

sentences.en: We'll probably cut the hours less.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会进一步缩短工作时间。

sentences.en: I don't know what else to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还能做什么了。

sentences.en: Right.
How are you feeling about those changes and sort of looking at the end of the year?
sentences.zh: 面对这些变化以及即将到来的年底，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: Well, I'm very stressed out because we really don't want to stop this program at all now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我压力非常大，因为我们现在真的不想停止这个项目。

sentences.en: OK, well, thank you so much, Mohamed.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，穆罕默德。

sentences.en: Good luck.
All right.
God bless.
Bye bye.
Thanks.
Bye bye.
We'll be right back.
Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Pennsylvania, Nevada and Minnesota all certified Joe Biden's election victory, rebuffing efforts by President Trump to delay the process.
sentences.zh: 周二，宾夕法尼亚州、内华达州和明尼苏达州都认证了乔·拜登的选举胜利，回击了特朗普总统推迟这一进程的努力。

sentences.en: Those certifications, combined with those in Georgia and Michigan, have left Trump with few ways to block or overturn the election results.
sentences.zh: 这些认证加上佐治亚州和密歇根州的认证，让特朗普几乎没有办法阻止或推翻选举结果。

sentences.en: And U.S.
stock markets surged to record levels on Tuesday after the Trump administration began the transfer of power to Biden and after Biden appointed Janet Yellen,
sentences.zh: 股市周二飙升至纪录高位，此前特朗普政府开始向拜登移交权力，且拜登任命了

sentences.en: an advocate of government intervention in the economy, as his Treasury secretary.
sentences.zh: 主张政府干预经济的珍妮特·耶伦担任财政部长。

sentences.en: The stock market, Dow Jones Industrial Average, just hit 30,000, which is the highest in history.
sentences.zh: 股市道琼斯工业平均指数刚刚突破3万点，创下历史最高纪录。

sentences.en: We've never broken 30,000.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which fell below 20,000 points at the start of the pandemic, surpassed 30,000 on Tuesday, a milestone that President Trump,
sentences.zh: 在疫情爆发之初跌破2万点的道琼斯工业平均指数周二突破了3万点，特朗普总统

sentences.en: during a news conference, called historic.
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上称这一里程碑为历史性的。

sentences.en: That's a sacred number, 30,000.
sentences.zh: 这是一个神圣的数字，3万点。

sentences.en: Nobody thought they'd ever see it.
sentences.zh: 谁也没想到他们能看到这一天。

sentences.zh: 本期《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.zh: 我是指，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.

sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？
